Okay, here's a table showing the approximate top 10 holdings of the Nasdaq-100 index (as of today, October 26, 2023). Please note that the exact rankings and figures can fluctuate daily, so this is a snapshot. Also, P/E ratios are approximations and can vary depending on the source and calculation method (trailing vs. forward).

| Rank | Company                     | Ticker | Approximate Market Cap (USD Billion) | Approximate P/E Ratio | Sector          |
|------|-----------------------------|--------|--------------------------------------|-----------------------|-----------------|
| 1    | Apple Inc.                  | AAPL   | ~$2,800                               | ~29                   | Technology      |
| 2    | Microsoft Corporation       | MSFT   | ~$2,500                               | ~32                   | Technology      |
| 3    | Amazon.com, Inc.           | AMZN   | ~$1,400                               |   ~75 (or loss if negative earnings)   | Consumer Discretionary |
| 4    | NVIDIA Corporation          | NVDA   | ~$1,100                               | ~45                   | Technology      |
| 5    | Alphabet Inc. (Class A)    | GOOGL  | ~$1,600            | ~20                   | Technology      |
| 6    | Alphabet Inc. (Class C)        | GOOG   | ~$1,600          | ~20                     | Technology      |
| 7    | Tesla, Inc. | TSLA   | ~$750                                    | ~62                  | Consumer Discretionary |
| 8    | Meta Platforms, Inc.           | META   | ~$750                             | ~25                   | Technology      |
| 9    | Broadcom Inc. | AVGO   | ~$300                           | ~27                   | Technology      |
| 10    | Costco Wholesale Corp. | COST   | ~$300                              | ~38                   | Consumer Staples       |

**Important Considerations and Disclaimers:**

*   **Approximations:**  Market capitalization and P/E ratios are constantly changing. The numbers above are approximate and based on publicly available data as of today, October 26, 2023, and may vary slightly depending on the source.
*   **Source Variability:**  Data for market cap and P/E can slightly differ from various financial data providers (e.g., Yahoo Finance, Google Finance, Bloomberg, etc.).
*   **P/E Ratio Caveats:**
    *   P/E ratios are most useful for companies with consistent profits.
    *   Companies with negative earnings have undefined P/E ratios.
    *   P/E ratios are just one metric; they don't tell the whole story.
*   **Index Composition Changes:** The Nasdaq-100 is rebalanced periodically, meaning that the holdings and their weights can change.
*   **Investment Advice:**  This information is for informational purposes only and is **not** investment advice.  Always do your own thorough research and/or consult with a qualified financial advisor before making any investment decisions.
* **Weights:** These are the largest *holdings* in terms of market capitalization, and also represent the approximate weight of each stock in the NASDAQ-100 index as a whole i.e. Apple makes up about 10% of the index by market cap.  The index is market-cap weighted.

To get the most up-to-date information, regularly refer to reputable financial data sources like:

*   Nasdaq.com (the official Nasdaq website)
*   Financial news websites (e.g., Yahoo Finance, Bloomberg, Reuters)
*   Financial data providers (e.g., FactSet, Refinitiv)
